string.text: You blacked out in the dead zone. A Monolith patrol found the body before you woke up.
The air settles: no more emissions will hit this sector before the raid ends.

There is so much anomalous energy here that spikes — and with them new artefacts — hit about every five minutes. Dangerous or not, crowds of stalkers rushed in for the loot. The Zone's wardens killed them all. Will I be next?
We are coming for you, heretic. Take what you can and run. And do not dare fall asleep. We will show no mercy.
